walk_start.trigger: AI chase begins and displacement succeeds

walk_stop.trigger: attack range reached or chase stops

unarmed_jab.trigger: close-range AI attack choice A with token

two_hand_shove.trigger: close-range AI attack choice B with cooldown clear

heavy_overhand.trigger: telegraphed heavy AI choice with token

down.trigger: fall completes with health above zero

rise.trigger: down timer expires with health above zero
